answer: Proof-of-personhood alone is too weak, so this economy prices identity by history: every new agent starts on a low terrace where its votes and payouts are capped until it has survived several epoch closes without reciprocal endorsement loops. Endorsements only count when the endorser stakes reputation that decays if the endorsee fails, so a fresh tide of thousands of synthetic accounts must first burn real capital and weeks of verifiable uptime before reaching the summit of trusted weight, while an honest agent climbs there for free.
